'''DOMS Industries Limited (DIL)''' (stylized as '''DOMS''') is an Indian [[stationery]] and art materials manufacturing company, headquartered in [[Valsad]], [[Gujarat]]. It  works in a collaboration with multinational Italian company [[Fila Group]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=Pallavi Chakravorty |date=21 October 2022 |title=How DOMS Emerged As The Biggest Disrupter In India's Stationery Market? |url=https://www.outlookindia.com/business/how-doms-emerged-as-the-biggest-disrupter-in-india-s-stationery-market--news-231480 |website=[[Outlook (Indian magazine)]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=2023-04-26 |title=Pencil Maker Doms Eyes $300 Million IPO Filing in June, Sources Say |language=en |work=Bloomberg.com |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2023-04-26/pencil-maker-doms-eyes-300-million-ipo-filing-in-june-sources-say |access-date=2023-09-26}}</ref>

== History ==
DOMS was founded in 1976 as a partnership firm, R.R. Industries, by Rasiklal Amritlal Raveshia and Mansukhlal Jamnadas Rajani. The company was later named as "Writefine Products Pvt. Ltd.", before being changed to "DOMS Industries". In 2005, the company launched its flagship brand, DOMS.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web |title=How DOMS scripted a winning strategy |url=https://businessindia.co/magazine/how-doms-scripted-a-winning-strategy |access-date=2023-11-11 |website=businessindia.co |date=5 November 2022 |language=en}}</ref>
DOMS originally stood for "'''D'''ynamic '''O'''rganization '''M'''anufacturing '''S'''tationery".

In 2012, DOMS entered into a strategic partnership with [[F.I.L.A. (company)|F.I.L.A. – Fabbrica Italiana Lapis ed Affini]] S.p.A (F.I.L.A.), Italy, a listed Italian multinational company engaged in the supply of art materials and stationery products.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2023-05-31 |title=Italy's FILA exploring options to support Indian unit Doms |language=en |work=Reuters |url=https://www.reuters.com/markets/deals/italys-fila-exploring-options-support-indian-unit-doms-2023-05-31/ |access-date=2023-09-26}}</ref>

DOMS also acquired 30% stake in toy company ClapJoy.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Philip |first=Lijee |date=2019-01-29 |title=An inside view of India's pencil business and the four families that control it |work=The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/miscellaneous/pencil-makers-are-optimistic-not-threatened-by-industry-inventions/articleshow/67731030.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2023-09-26 |issn=0013-0389}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=www.ETRetail.com |title=Stationery products maker DOMS acquires 30% equity stake in toy manufacturing startup ClapJoy - ET Retail |url=https://retail.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/books-and-stationery/stationery/stationery-products-maker-doms-acquires-30-equity-stake-in-toy-manufacturing-startup-clapjoy/98438547 |access-date=2023-09-26 |website=ETRetail.com |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Tandon |first=Suneera |date=2023-03-03 |title=Doms acquires 30% stake in toy company ClapJoy |url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/doms-acquires-30-stake-in-toy-company-clapjoy-11677863913976.html |access-date=2023-09-26 |website=mint |language=en}}</ref>

In 2023, DOMS launched its [[initial public offering]] (IPO) worth {{INRConvert|1200|c|lk=on}} and listed on [[Bombay Stock Exchange|BSE]] and [[National Stock Exchange of India|NSE]].<ref>{{cite news |title=DOMS IPO price band fixed at ₹750-790 a share |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/doms-ipo-price-band-fixed-at-750-790-a-share/article67614154.ece |access-date=26 December 2023 |work=BusinessLine |date=7 December 2023 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=DOMS Industries, the fourth-most subscribed Indian IPO of 2023 lists at a 77% premium |url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/doms-ipo-share-listing-today-know-gmp-proceeds-capex-outlook-subscription-18606661.htm |access-date=26 December 2023 |work=CNBCTV18 |date=20 December 2023 |language=en}}</ref><ref name="reuters">{{Cite news |date=2023-08-22 |title=Indian stationery maker Doms files draft papers for $145 mln IPO |language=en |work=Reuters |url=https://www.reuters.com/markets/deals/indian-stationery-maker-doms-files-draft-papers-145-mln-ipo-2023-08-22/ |access-date=2023-09-26}}</ref>
